sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Libera is one of the playable character in the Grand Quest. She was the captain of the Eighth Division of Demon Slayers.

sections.title: History
sections.content:
Libera was a member of Imperial Guard, and born in a noble family in Randall Empire. After she got summoning powers, she joined the Summoners' Hall, despite the strong rejection from her family. She kept polishing her skills even after her family dismissed her, and she became the captain of Eighth Division of Demon Slayers.

After the squadron left Griff in Celgrad, Libera acted as Krantz's adviser. After Rhoa and Kafka separated themselves to fight the demon beast, she and Krantz crossed the path with another powerful demon. After assuring Mirfah that they would come back safely to Elgaia together, she ordered him to run and wait for them in safe place, as she joined Krantz in their last struggle against the demon. Libera met her demise after her bloody struggle against the Heresy Demon after that.

sections.title: Character
sections.content: Libera is shown as a cheerful woman, as she often acts as the mood-maker of the squadron, but it doesn't mean that she can't be serious. Her serious side is shown when she helped Krantz when the latter was anxious with his own judgments.
